notes.title: Developer’s Note – Monster Movement, AoE Adjustment, and the Flow of Battle
notes.content:
Hello, this is the Dicey Tales development team.

Combat in Dicey Tales is designed as a turn-based tactical puzzle. For this reason, most monsters have traditionally been given relatively high mobility.

However, due to recent updates:
[list]
[*]Movement has become more difficult to secure (e.g., reduced number of movement dice faces)
[*]We aim to improve strategic diversity, including better utilization of positioning.
[/list]

We are currently rebalancing monster movement values and their initial placements accordingly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45301967/e23b9f1e7fb25f3deb58bb51ac635f86f98e7c0c.png[/img]
Before Adjustment

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45301967/ecd840d038a6a60a9eef4e44c48dd621e9ea8718.png[/img]
After Adjustment

Excessively limiting movement could lead to a situation where players can easily evade all threats with just a few movement dice, potentially making combat less strategic and more monotonous. We are carefully tuning unreasonable patterns while ensuring players can gain strategic advantages through positioning and formation.

We are also working to enrich the tactical experience by introducing more varied obstacles and shifting patterns on a per-turn basis, all while maintaining the puzzle-like essence of combat.

Additionally, monsters with area attacks are being updated to avoid repetitive AoE use every turn. Each monster will gradually gain its own unique pattern to create more dynamic and engaging battles.

Your feedback is always a great help.
Feel free to share your thoughts and suggestions through our Discord or Steam Community.

notes.title: Skill Branch System Update
notes.content:
Hello, this is the Dicey Tales development team.
This update brings many changes, including the Skill Branch System, which we have previously introduced through our developer notes.

[h2]Skill Branch System[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45301967/0dbfbc105c7cb9b7d06a130e0f751e8d837e3849.png[/img]

[list]
[*] All characters will learn new traits/skills or enhance existing ones at levels 3, 6, and 9.
[*] At level 6, you can choose between two traits. At level 9, the effect you receive will depend on the trait chosen at level 6.
[/list]

To accommodate this, skill balance and hero growth mechanics have been adjusted.

[h2]Mechanic Expansion[/h2]

We have changed and expanded mechanics so that a character’s role and playstyle can significantly vary depending on the skill branch chosen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45301967/fa41930176a765b79bcce7f50ed43e2423c3d7f0.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] [Burn] (Updated): Burn now accumulates stacks equal to the damage dealt. Each turn, the stacks decrease by half, and at the start of a turn, damage is taken equal to the number of stacks.
[*] [Frost/Freeze]: Frost still prevents movement. When Frost reaches 3 or more stacks, it turns into Freeze, which lasts for 1 turn, preventing action. Damage taken while Frozen is doubled, and the effect is removed.
[*] [Enhance]: The next attack deals double damage.
[*] [Coordination]: When an ally within range attacks, you attack together.
[*] [Counterattack]: When hit by an enemy within range, you counterattack.
[/list]

Additional mechanics, including dice generation and skill enhancements, have been introduced. Over 80 new skills and two new heroes have been added.

[h2]Reroll System & New Chronicle Features[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45301967/3bdfd28df85a3e97d268e0de3729b9c14be29732.png[/img]

[list]
[*] The Reroll System has been added as a default feature. You can drag dice to reroll them. Initially, you have 2 rerolls per battle, but you can gain more rerolls through the [Pioneer of Fate] chronicle.
[list][*]To support rerolling, a new hover feature has been added to check the dice face composition.[/list][*] The [Mercenary Join] chronicle has been added, allowing you to recruit a hero early in the game.
[*] Tasha and Valla will no longer appear in the early game. They will now join through dedicated events. Completing these events will also unlock them at the inn through a chronicle.
[/list]

[h2]Other Updates[/h2]

[list]
[*] Richard has been added as a new starting hero. He can be unlocked through quest progression and chronicles. Richard is designed to support mage-type characters.
[*] Initial starting heroes will no longer be recruitable at inns.
[*] Three new events have been added.
[*] UI enhancements have been made to improve buff effect visibility.
[*] Performance optimization and cartoon-style lighting have been added.
[*] You can now end turns using the Space key.
[*] New game speed options have been added. Enemy/ally turns can now be distinguished, and a [Ultra Speed] mode has been introduced.
[/list]

Your feedback is incredibly valuable to us.
Please feel free to share your thoughts anytime!

notes.title: Developer Notes - Character Introduction - Flare
notes.content:
With the introduction of the character branching system, the mechanics of all characters have been enhanced. Let's take a look at how one particular character, Flare, has evolved.

[h3]Flare[/h3]

Flare has always been a powerful dealer of burn damage, but with the addition of branching, his power can be expanded in more diverse ways.

Characters typically have the opportunity to enhance their skills or traits when they level up at levels 3, 6, and 9. At level 6, you usually have the choice between two traits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45301967/a0b2985f893ce9db74c7c2733e0432a976e02d9b.gif[/img]

Flare can enhance his powerful area damage by requiring a turn of casting.
The attack occurs at the start of the next turn, so you may need to hold or move monsters in a specific direction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45301967/c6b3681bd0b653cdbe5fb1f4b4861939319d390a.gif[/img]

Furthermore, Flare can now set up a [Fire Zone]. Using traits that enhance the damage of the Fire Zone, he can inflict sustained area damage over a broad area.
Additional relics that utilize these terrain effects are also being developed.

Similar enhancements are being developed for other characters to offer diverse usability.

Your feedback is very important to us.
Please feel free to send us your opinions at any time!

notes.title: Developer Notes - Dice Reroll
notes.content:
Hello, this is the Dicey Tales development team. 
This week, we want to introduce a feature we are currently developing.

[h3]Dice Reroll System[/h3]

[b]Dice[/b] are a core element of strategy in Dicey Tales. 

Each turn, the dice you roll can change the situation, requiring you to come up with [b]various strategies[/b].
However, due to the nature of dice, there's an element of [b]reliance on luck[/b]. 

While unpredictability is one of the charms of the game, 
we have created [b]a reroll feature[/b] to allow for [b]deeper strategic choices[/b]. 

You can [b]purchase reroll opportunities[/b] through [b]the Hero's Chronicle system[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45301967/45c95aa95ad7329cd81a28a31c331440eaa4e032.gif[/img]

[b]Your feedback is very important to us[/b]. 
Feel free to send us your thoughts at any time!

Thank you.

notes.title: Developer Notes
notes.content:
Hello, this is the Dicey Tales development team.
This week, we want to share some exciting developments we are currently working on.

[h3]Introduction of the Skill Branching System[/h3]

As we prepare for the new update, we are focusing on providing a different experience each time you play. We are developing a new system that not only enhances intuitive usability but also incorporates extremely varied and even radical concepts into the character designs. This will allow players, as they become more skilled, to experiment with different combinations and try completely new ways of playing. Through this, we aim to expand replayability and create a foundation for experimenting with more diverse methods based on player feedback.

One reason the existing hero level-ups might not seem particularly appealing is that the changes before and after leveling up are mostly numerical. To address this, we have developed a system that adds directions for growth when a hero reaches a certain level. This branching system will evolve gameplay from simple dice skill-based play to utilizing unique character skills and exploring combinations for more powerful effects.

The Skill Branching System will be a feature where players can choose from multiple skills displayed on the leveling-up screen once characters reach certain levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45301967/7dbeb3eeaaebafff49feaa8fb15ee406be4dc6fb.gif[/img]
[i]This footage is from development and may differ from the actual update.[/i]

We also plan to introduce new relics, characters, and elements of the Hero's Chronicle as part of diversifying the skills.

[h3]Update Cycle and Development Process [/h3]

The Dicey Tales development team has been consistently rolling out weekly updates.

However, as this development is of a larger scale, more time will be needed to provide a high-quality update. We are incorporating more exciting ideas than initially planned and are fully committed to this update. While focusing on this new update, we will temporarily pause our weekly updates but will continue to share details about the development process and elements through our developer notes each week.

Thank you.

First, we would like to thank everyone who has been waiting for our game.
Although Dicey Tales has been officially launched on Steam, our team is fully aware that there is still much work to be done to enhance the quality of the game.
Your feedback and suggestions will be a great help to us during this process. We promise to continue delivering updates and improvements to provide you with a better gaming experience.
